definitions.explanation: A collapse of earth and rock from a slope, often triggered by heavy rain or earthquakes.

examples.japanese: {土砂崩|どしゃくず}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}した→発生する：25529_hasseisuru⟧。
{土砂崩|どしゃくず}れ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{道路|どうろ}→道路：01481_douro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{塞|ふさ}がれた→塞ぐ：00046_fusagu⟧。
examples.english: The road was blocked by a landslide.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大雨|おおあめ}→大雨：03015_ooame⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{各地|かくち}→各地：00155_kakuchi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{土砂崩|どしゃくず}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きた→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。
examples.english: Landslides occurred in various areas due to the heavy rain.

notes:
{土砂崩|どしゃくず}れ is a common natural disaster in mountainous Japan.
